summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.09/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.09 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 3, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 17¢ lower than a week ago, 37¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.37 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.90) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.29).
